title: KV cache fragmentation baseline results (pre-compaction) — regions/models/scenarios
tab_readme:
Purpose
- Capture baseline KV cache fragmentation + tail latency behavior BEFORE compaction/eviction work lands (flag OFF).
- Provide a reference dataset for:
  (1) validating improvements (compaction-enabled builds),
  (2) defining regression gates for perf-canary and runtime release gating,
  (3) clarifying which mixes/regions/pools are worst.

Definitions (as measured by runtime metrics introduced in PR-18423 draft naming; may evolve)
- fragmentation_ratio_avg: (free_bytes_in_allocated_segments / total_allocated_bytes). Intuition: holes inside KV cache address space that cannot be used for new allocations without compaction.
- fragmentation_ratio_p95: 95th percentile of fragmentation_ratio sampled every 5s during run.
- alloc_failures_per_1m_req: KV cache allocation failures (including fallback paths) normalized per 1,000,000 requests.
- compaction_enabled: FALSE for all runs in this sheet.

Latency metrics
- e2e_p95_ms / e2e_p99_ms: request end-to-end latency (server-side), per scenario definition.
- decode_p99_ms: decode phase p99 (server-side), where applicable.

Run conditions
- Runtime build: runtime-main @ 2025-02-17 nightly (pre-compaction series), GPU pools as listed.
- Workload generator: benchmark-lab @ PR-912 baseline harness.
- Note: absolute latency values can shift with unrelated kernel changes; treat the combination of fragmentation + alloc_failures + tail spikes as the primary signal.

Notes / caveats
- Several scenarios show "tail cliffs" where alloc_failures_per_1m_req stays low but e2e_p99 jumps sharply; these correlate with allocator search/eviction churn and occasional re-allocations (see postmortem PM-2025-02-11).
- Dedicated pools generally have lower fragmentation (more stable tenant mix), but long-context bursts still create pathological holes.

Owner notes (Rina)
- Once compaction flag lands, we will add a parallel sheet version with compaction_enabled=TRUE and compute deltas + pass/fail against Regression gate tab.

tab_charts_notes:
Charts (generated in Drive UI; documented here for reproducibility)

1) Fragmentation ratio over time — RB-0002 (us-east-1 hosted H100, llama-3.1-70b, bursty_mix)
- X: time (s)
- Y: fragmentation_ratio (sampled every 5s)
- Pattern: sawtooth with step-ups during burst windows; baseline returns only partially during troughs.
- Annotate burst windows and allocator churn log markers ("kv_alloc_scan_ms" spikes).

2) e2e_p99_ms vs fragmentation_ratio_p95 scatter (all runs)
- X: fragmentation_ratio_p95
- Y: e2e_p99_ms
- Observed: non-linear knee around frag_p95 ~0.40 for hosted pools; above this, p99 variance increases significantly.

3) alloc_failures_per_1m_req vs e2e_p99_ms (hosted only)
- Shows that alloc failures explain only part of p99 spikes; many spikes occur with low failure counts (search/eviction churn + re-alloc).

4) Heatmap — frag_p95 by (scenario x pool)
- Rows: scenarios (steady_short, bursty_mix, multi_tenant_mixed, long_context_burst)
- Cols: pool (hosted H100, hosted A100, dedicated H100, dedicated A100)
- Biggest cells: long_context_burst on hosted H100; multi_tenant_mixed on hosted A100.

5) Output length sensitivity — RB-0002 vs RB-0015
- Same scenario + model + region, only output_tokens differ (256 vs 1024).
- Demonstrates fragmentation and p99 sensitivity grows with longer decode lifetimes (more interleaving).
tab_regression_gate:
Goal
- Define initial (conservative) regression gates for perf-canary + release gating once compaction flag is introduced.
- Gates are based on baseline distributions in this sheet; tuned to avoid blocking unrelated releases while still catching fragmentation regressions.

Gate philosophy
- For compaction_enabled=FALSE: we mostly use these baselines as "do not get worse" constraints.
- For compaction_enabled=TRUE: we expect improvements in frag_p95 and alloc_failures; we allow small median overhead but cap p99 regression.

Metrics used
- e2e_p99_ms_delta_pct: (candidate_e2e_p99_ms - baseline_e2e_p99_ms) / baseline_e2e_p99_ms
- frag_p95_delta_abs: candidate_frag_p95 - baseline_frag_p95
- alloc_failures_delta: candidate_alloc_failures_per_1m_req - baseline_alloc_failures_per_1m_req

Baseline anchors (from this sheet)
- Worst-case hosted burst p99 observed: 3880ms (RB-0015)
- Typical hosted burst p99 range (H100, llama-3.1-70b, output 256): 1400–2000ms (RB-0002/RB-0007)
- Worst frag_p95 observed: 0.55 (RB-0015)

Proposed gates (v0)
A) Safety gate (all scenarios):
- e2e_p99_ms_delta_pct must be <= +8% (candidate vs baseline) for any matching scenario/region/pool/model
- AND alloc_failures_delta must be <= +1.0 per 1m req

B) Fragmentation regression gate (hosted pools only):
- frag_p95_delta_abs must be <= +0.03

C) Expected-improvement check (compaction_enabled=TRUE only; soft gate / warning for first 2 weeks):
- For bursty_mix and multi_tenant_mixed scenarios: frag_p95_delta_abs should be <= -0.05 (i.e., improve by at least 0.05)
- alloc_failures_per_1m_req should reduce by >= 30% OR remain < 2.0 absolute

D) Median protection gate (compaction_enabled=TRUE only):
- e2e_p50_ms_delta_pct must be <= +3% (to catch compaction overhead affecting average latency)

Gate mapping to canary
- Recommended perf-canary scenarios to run:
  1) bursty_mix / us-east-1 / hosted-shared-h100 / llama-3.1-70b / output_tokens=256 (baseline RB-0002)
  2) multi_tenant_mixed / us-east-1 / hosted-shared-a100 / llama-3.1-70b / output_tokens=256 (baseline RB-0005)
  3) long_context_burst / us-east-1 / hosted-shared-h100 / qwen2.5-32b / max_context=64k (baseline RB-0004)
  4) dedicated_long_context / us-east-1 / dedicated-dc17-h100 / llama-3.1-70b (baseline RB-0009)

Open questions (to resolve before moving gates to "hard")
- Should gates be weighted by traffic tier (Hosted vs Dedicated) and SLO class?
- Do we want separate gates for A100 vs H100 due to different absolute latency scaling?
- Fragmentation_ratio definition: confirm numerator/denominator matches allocator implementation post refactor (PR-18431).

Change log
- 2025-03-05: Added RB-0015 (output length sensitivity) and bumped proposed frag improvement check from -0.03 to -0.05 for bursty_mix/multi_tenant (based on clearer knee around frag_p95~0.40).
